judgment.notes: Reviewed all four uses of the conditional M001 statement. A001 takes both factors to the kth time component, with derivatives (u_t)_k; A002 takes u_k and (u_t)_k, with derivatives (u_t)_k and (u_tt)_k; A003 takes both factors to u_k on the jth spatial coordinate line; A004 takes u_k and (u_j)_k on that line, with derivatives (u_j)_k and (u_jj)_k. In every case scalar field and algebra are R, so all normed-field/ring/algebra premises hold for the standard real structures. H002 supplies the requisite derivatives, D003-D006 identify them, and BG002 checks component passage. At r>0 the time extensions agree locally with the original curves (BG005), so no derivative at or across zero is needed. For spatial applications the coordinate is x_j and time is fixed positive. M001 yields exactly the component-product derivatives used; BG003-BG006 cover finite sums and differentiation of the constant identities. There are no E applications.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
